linkedin_post: TRI’s TR7600 SV AXI Launch: What Higher-Throughput X-ray Inspection Changes for SMT Lines: the engineering question is not only scan speed. For SMT teams, higher-throughput AXI matters when it improves hidden-joint coverage, review consistency, and connection to MES/SPI/AOI process data. What is your biggest AXI constraint today: programming, review load, sampling policy, or line integration? #SMT #AXI #QualityEngineering
forum_answer:
Key points:
- Validate throughput on your own board mix, not only vendor demos.
- Check BGA/THT/SiP defect coverage by resolution and package family.
- Measure review time and false calls alongside scan speed.
- Confirm CFX/Hermes/MES integration if AXI data is used for traceability.
- Use AXI findings for upstream root-cause work, not just board disposition.
